title: Negotiate PHXP asynchronously without weakening ownership
description:
## Parent

`phx-1ir`

## What to build

Integrate PHXP into the Tokio path using bounded blocking capacity where needed while preserving authentication, framing, descriptor validation, and irreversible ownership semantics.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] At most 256 PHXP operations and 32 probe workers contribute to validated `TasksMax` demand without unbounded queued work.
- [ ] Cancellation before descriptor delivery may relay; cancellation/failure after delivery never relays.
- [ ] Existing Linux and macOS receivers and handoff regression suites remain compatible.

## Blocked by

- `phx-1f6` — Serve bounded ClientHello routing on Tokio
- `phx-1iq` — Activate late Workloads with production PHXP endpoints

comments.author: Christian Geuer-Pollmann
comments.text: Blocked after candidate commits eec193d and efe3ecc. Linux Definition of Done passed: cargo fmt -- --check; cargo test; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings. The clean macOS checkout was fast-forwarded to efe3eccc0a6ee5cee927ae39099dc3a1f8ced7b6. Darwin cargo fmt and all PHXP/root tests passed, including descriptor transfer, partial-send ownership, and inert-descriptor acknowledgement behavior, but the required full command failed before clippy in ingress_config::tests::public_observability_is_loopback_only_bounded_and_explicitly_expiring. That pre-existing test captures SystemTime::now(), writes expires_at_unix_seconds = now + 3601, then production loading reads the wall clock again; if at least one second elapses, the remaining duration is accepted as <= 3600. Failure at src/ingress_config.rs:919 returned Ok with expiry 1788370305. This is unrelated to phx-115, so prompt.md requires leaving the issue open rather than dismissing or fixing it in this run. Exact failing gate: PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin cargo fmt -- --check && cargo test && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings.

title: Publish bounded metrics and privacy-preserving events
description:
## Parent

`phx-z3w`

## What to build

Expose optional loopback-only Prometheus output and structured stderr events that make route, capacity, handoff, relay, and reload state operable without attacker-driven cardinality.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Metric labels are limited to bounded declared identities and never include source IP, arbitrary SNI, connection IDs, certificates, or error strings.
- [ ] Prometheus response size and listener exposure are bounded and provide no mutation path.
- [ ] Sampled source diagnostics require explicit expiry and normal logs omit source IP.

## Blocked by

- `phx-27w` — Authorize machine-readable health and root-only mutation
- `phx-2x5` — Expose bounded overload events without log amplification
close_reason: Resolved in e3933193e728aa10efc05a590e910e682f66f345. Added a GET-only loopback Prometheus listener with 1 MiB responses, fixed-enum and bounded Route Declaration metrics, rate-limited structured route/delivery/reload events, and explicitly expiring sampled source diagnostics while preserving default development activation. Regression: tests/observability.rs::metrics_listener_is_bounded_read_only_and_uses_only_declared_labels, source_diagnostics_are_sampled_only_before_the_explicit_expiry, and unavailable_metrics_listener_does_not_stop_the_data_plane.

title: Drain async ingress with explicit ownership-aware cancellation
description:
## Parent

`phx-1ir`

## What to build

Coordinate activated listeners, pre-routing tasks, PHXP negotiations, relays, state flush, and endpoint cleanup through the accepted shutdown state machine.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Admission stops immediately and pre-routing cancels without leaks.
- [ ] PHXP ownership resolves safely; handed-off connections survive ingress exit.
- [ ] Relays drain for at most 60 seconds, then close with a bounded diagnostic and controlled shutdown.

## Blocked by

- `phx-ok1` — Relay TLS asynchronously with half-close and idle policy
- `phx-115` — Negotiate PHXP asynchronously without weakening ownership

title: Exercise adversarial public ingress end to end
description:
## Parent

`phx-3vs`

## What to build

Build a deterministic Linux production harness with private test CA, exact declarations, relay and handoff Workloads, malformed PHXP, slow TLS clients, IPv4/IPv6 generators, and resource sampling.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All 20 required scenarios in Phase 8 execute with machine-checkable assertions.
- [ ] The harness proves zero probes for undeclared SNI, safe ownership transitions, source-table churn, bounded logs, reload, restart, rotation, and drain.
- [ ] Resource counts return to baseline and admitted traffic has no routing errors.

## Blocked by

- `phx-124` — Drain async ingress with explicit ownership-aware cancellation

title: Serve bounded ClientHello routing on Tokio
description:
## Parent

`phx-1ir`

## What to build

Move listener adoption, admission, total-deadline non-consuming ClientHello inspection, and exact route selection into one owned Tokio task path.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The 64 KiB limit, two-second total deadline, `MSG_PEEK`, and no-consume-before-delivery semantics remain intact.
- [ ] Tasks are tracked and cancelled; no unbounded channel or detached task exists.
- [ ] Thousands of idle/pre-routing sockets do not create proportional native threads and all prior routing/admission tests pass.

## Blocked by

- `phx-ovf` — Bound threaded admission from accept through relay
- `phx-3q9` — Route one exact declaration only after certificate proof
close_reason: Resolved in 3c9211f. Tokio now owns bounded listener and pre-routing ClientHello tasks with non-consuming peeks, absolute deadlines, bounded coordinator/delivery queues, eager JoinSet reaping, and prompt cancellation. Regression: 2,000 idle ClientHellos retain constant native-thread usage and cancel on STOP; deadline, queue, and reaping unit tests cover lifecycle edges.

title: Activate late Workloads with production PHXP endpoints
description:
## Parent

`phx-2dv`

## What to build

Reconcile a Workload that allocates and binds after ingress startup, derive its private PHXP endpoint from logical ID and role, and prefer verified handoff with safe relay fallback.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Production endpoints live under `/run/phx-port/handoff` and survive ingress restart without stale-global cleanup.
- [ ] A late Workload becomes active only after reachability and certificate proof.
- [ ] Tests distinguish successful original-descriptor handoff from relay and preserve pre/post-delivery ownership rules on Linux and macOS.

## Blocked by

- `phx-3q9` — Route one exact declaration only after certificate proof
close_reason: Resolved in 7b3b95b (implementation begins d1b58f4). Late declared Workloads activate only after registry reachability and exact-hostname TLS proof, use deterministic logical-ID/role PHXP endpoints under /run/phx-port/handoff, prefer original-descriptor handoff, and permit relay only before descriptor delivery. Regression: proxy::tests::late_public_workload_activates_only_after_registration_and_certificate_proof failed before and passes after; proxy::tests::public_route_hands_the_original_descriptor_to_its_logical_workload_endpoint proves original descriptor handoff with zero relay on Linux. Darwin evidence at 7b3b95b: root cargo fmt -- --check, cargo test (77 unit, 4 ingress CLI, 10 workload/profile, including sendmsg ownership and both public routing regressions), and strict clippy; Rust sample fmt/test (27)/strict clippy; native Rustler cargo test (9); Phoenix format/test (12); Elixir sample format/test (4).

title: Canary one hostname through renewal and rollback
description:
## Parent

`phx-3vs`

## What to build

Deploy one low-risk declared hostname, exercise the complete certificate and restart lifecycle, and prove both rollback paths within five minutes before production promotion.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A full automated DNS-01 renewal succeeds with visible SNI and no port 80/ECH dependency.
- [ ] Ingress restart, Workload restart, PHXP endpoint loss, relay recovery, and certificate rotation are observed with accepted health behavior.
- [ ] Rollback succeeds to the preceding binary/registry snapshot and to independently generated HAProxy or NGINX-stream config using declarations plus stable ports.

## Blocked by

- `phx-3o3` — Qualify the 4-vCPU 8-GiB production envelope

title: Authorize machine-readable health and root-only mutation
description:
## Parent

`phx-z3w`

## What to build

Provide stable JSON status and live/ready commands over the local control endpoint with per-connection peer authentication and command-aware authorization.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Service UID and `phx-port-admin` may inspect bounded status, routes, and readiness.
- [ ] Only UID 0 may reload, stop, or mutate production because Workloads share the service UID.
- [ ] Development retains its current-user full-authority socket and unsafe parent/symlink paths fail closed.

## Blocked by

- `phx-3bn` — Split production intent, stable assignments, and derived state
- `phx-311` — Fail closed on bounded route and registry conflicts
close_reason: Resolved in 62e6923. Added bounded schema-v1 JSON status, live/ready checks, per-connection SO_PEERCRED/getpeereid authorization, phx-port-admin read access, and UID 0-only public RELOAD/STOP. Regression: tests/control_plane_cli.rs::public_health_is_machine_readable_and_service_uid_cannot_mutate failed before with the proxy usage error and passes after; tests/control_plane_cli.rs::uid_zero_can_reload_and_stop_public_ingress proves real UID 0 mutation on Linux. Linux gates: cargo fmt -- --check; cargo test; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; full ignored privileged-startup suite; real systemd unit gate. macOS gates at 62e6923: cargo fmt -- --check; cargo test; real launchd gate; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; plutil -lint. The macOS UID 0-only ignored test could not run because that host has no noninteractive sudo; Linux provides the real UID 0 evidence while macOS normal and launchd tests exercise getpeereid.

title: Adopt launchd sockets and support bind-then-drop startup
description:
## Parent

`phx-z3w`

## What to build

Implement the same activated-listener contract through launchd and the explicit `sudo phx-port daemon --run-as USER --listen ...` bind-then-drop path.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] launchd descriptors are named, validated, nonblocking, and adopted without rebinding.
- [ ] Manual startup binds only explicit listeners, irreversibly drops groups/GID/UID before config/state/input, and rejects listener/config mismatch.
- [ ] Linux and macOS integration tests prove final identity and owned-file permissions; bare `sudo phx-port` semantics remain unchanged.

## Blocked by

- `phx-3bn` — Split production intent, stable assignments, and derived state
close_reason: Resolved in 63c197a. Added validated named launchd listener adoption and explicit bind-then-irreversibly-drop startup with exact post-drop listener/config matching, final identity and owned-runtime evidence on Linux and macOS, and packaged launchd service assets. Regression: tests/privileged_startup.rs and tests/launchd_socket_activation.rs.

title: Expose bounded overload events without log amplification
description:
## Parent

`phx-1nl`

## What to build

Turn all admission failures into bounded reason counters and rate-limited structured events while preserving immediate-close behavior.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No attacker-controlled source or arbitrary SNI becomes a metric label.
- [ ] Repeated saturation emits bounded aggregate logs rather than one event per connection.
- [ ] Tests prove counters and suppression for every admission reason.

## Blocked by

- `phx-ovf` — Bound threaded admission from accept through relay
close_reason: Resolved in d07248c. All fixed admission reasons now increment bounded counters and emit per-reason structured overload aggregates at most once per ten seconds; worker-queue saturation shares the path, and per-connection error strings are not logged. Regression: tests/ingress_limits_cli.rs::unix::repeated_global_overload_emits_one_bounded_aggregate_event.

title: Fail closed on bounded route and registry conflicts
description:
## Parent

`phx-2dv`

## What to build

Extend exact routing to bounded multi-route reconciliation with duplicate, port-collision, required/optional readiness, and atomic generation behavior.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Malformed/duplicate keys and shared-port conflicts cannot activate a route.
- [ ] Undeclared registry entries stay inactive with bounded diagnostics.
- [ ] A failed reload preserves the previous generation; required failures make readiness false while optional failures only degrade detail.

## Blocked by

- `phx-1iq` — Activate late Workloads with production PHXP endpoints
close_reason: Resolved in f8f14e8. Added bounded multi-route public reconciliation with normalized duplicate and shared-port conflict rejection, required/optional readiness, immutable generations, stale-probe rejection, and bounded diagnostics/state. Regression: public_profile_reconciles_multiple_routes_and_preserves_valid_generation.

title: Make diagnostic expiry validation deterministic
description:
## Parent

`phx-z3w`

## What to build

Remove the wall-clock race from public source-diagnostic expiry validation so the configured maximum lifetime is evaluated against one explicit reference instant and behaves identically on Linux and macOS.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Expiry exactly inside the one-hour maximum is accepted and expiry beyond it is rejected without depending on elapsed test/runtime seconds.
- [ ] Production parsing uses one captured reference instant for all related expiry checks.
- [ ] Linux and macOS run the deterministic regression under the full Rust Definition of Done.

## Blocked by

None - can start immediately.
close_reason: Resolved in fc0d7af. Source diagnostic expiry validation now uses one captured reference instant, accepting exactly 3600 seconds and rejecting 3601; Linux and macOS passed `cargo fmt -- --check`, `cargo test`, and `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`. Regression: ingress_config::tests::source_diagnostic_expiry_uses_explicit_reference_instant.

title: Split production intent, stable assignments, and derived state
description:
## Parent

`phx-z3w`

## What to build

Implement the accepted `/etc`, `/var/lib`, and `/run` boundaries with no-follow permission checks, atomic snapshots, migration tooling, and rollback-compatible registry handling.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Root-owned intent is never modified by Workloads; stable assignments and disposable route cache have distinct ownership and backup semantics.
- [ ] Runtime, handoff, control, and lock paths reject unsafe ownership, modes, and symlinks.
- [ ] The preceding binary can consume the retained schema or a permission-preserving snapshot restores it.

## Blocked by

- `phx-dtj` — Allocate logical Workload ports in an explicit public profile
close_reason: Resolved in 2f181a8 (implementation 941091e; macOS fixture corrections 43e9e16 and 2f181a8). Public intent, stable assignments, disposable route state, runtime/control/handoff paths, and locks now have distinct no-follow ownership and mode boundaries; migration publishes with atomic no-replace semantics and retains its rollback source; malformed development route cache is discarded without changing ports. Regression: production_migration_splits_derived_state_and_preserves_rollback_source; additional coverage includes migration_publication_refuses_destination_created_after_precheck and malformed_combined_route_state_is_discarded_without_changing_ports. Linux and macOS at 2f181a8: cargo fmt -- --check; cargo test; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings.

title: Validate typed ingress capacity before startup
description:
## Parent

`phx-1nl`

Introduce explicit typed limits that flow from configuration through startup validation and actionable operator diagnostics.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Unsafe zero, overflow, sublimit, timeout, FD-reserve, and task-budget combinations fail before listeners accept traffic.
- [ ] The transitional threaded defaults cap active work at 256 while development defaults remain compatible.
- [ ] Focused tests cover valid and invalid capacity relationships.

## Blocked by

None - can start immediately
close_reason: Resolved in 538d534. Added typed daemon capacity limits with pre-listener structural, RLIMIT_NOFILE reserve, and task-budget validation while preserving the threaded 256 ceiling and development startup. Regression: tests/ingress_limits_cli.rs invalid_capacity_is_rejected_before_listener_binding.

title: Qualify the 4-vCPU 8-GiB production envelope

Run the accepted 30-minute qualification on the target Linux VM and preserve machine-readable evidence for capacity defaults and deterministic shedding.

- [ ] 30,000 live connections sustain as 25,000 confirmed handoffs plus 5,000 relays at 1,000 accepts/second.

description:

Public mode now parses one exact Route Declaration, resolves only its logical Workload/role loopback port, activates and relays only after system-trusted exact-hostname TLS proof, and rejects undeclared SNI without probing. `phx-2dv`

Add explicit public-profile activation and stable logical Workload ID plus role allocation while preserving canonical-path development allocation unchanged.

title: Enforce bounded per-source pre-routing admission
description:
## Parent

`phx-1nl`

## What to build

Apply rate and simultaneous-pre-routing policy to exact IPv4 and configurable IPv6-prefix buckets using a bounded expiring table.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

- [ ] Default policy is 20 accepts/second, burst 40, and 16 simultaneous pre-routing connections per source bucket.
- [ ] CIDR overrides are operator-only and source state has deterministic TTL and maximum size.
- [ ] More than 16 established relays from one source remain possible after pre-routing permits release.

## Blocked by

- `phx-ovf` — Bound threaded admission from accept through relay
close_reason: Resolved in 46c66b0. Enforced exact-IPv4 and configurable-prefix IPv6 source rate/concurrency admission from the kernel peer address with bounded TTL/LRU state, operator-only CIDR policies, aggregate counters, and source-permit release before established relay lifetime. Regression: tests/ingress_limits_cli.rs::unix::source_pre_routing_limit_rejects_before_worker_and_recovers.

title: Relay TLS asynchronously with half-close and idle policy

title: Bound threaded admission from accept through relay
description:
## Parent

- [ ] Global, pre-routing, handoff, and relay limits are exact and observable.
- [ ] Source and pre-routing permits release after route selection while global relay capacity remains held to closure.

close_reason: Resolved in c01b554. Enforced global accept-rate and exact active/pre-routing/handoff/relay RAII capacity before bounded dispatch, with fixed workers, a one-slot queue, bounded probe thread creation, and observable limits/rejection reasons. Regression: tests/ingress_limits_cli.rs::unix::connection_admission_rejects_before_worker_and_recovers. Linux gates: cargo fmt -- --check && cargo test && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings. macOS gate on mini.geuer-pollmann.de at c01b554 with PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH: cargo fmt -- --check && cargo test && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings.

title: Run rootless ingress through systemd socket activation
description:
## Parent

`phx-z3w`

## What to build

Adopt named systemd listeners through the common activated-listener abstraction and ship a hardened system service/socket pair that owns port 443 while the data plane remains unprivileged.

Authoritative design: `docs/public-hosting-hardening-design.md` and `docs/public-hosting-hardening-implementation-plan.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Inherited descriptors are validated as expected listening TCP sockets and direct rebinding is skipped.
- [ ] Service sandbox, writable paths, `LimitNOFILE`, `TasksMax`, restart, and drain settings match the accepted design.
- [ ] A real unit test exercises startup, routing, state writes, control, and restart without UID 0 data-plane execution.

## Blocked by

- `phx-3bn` — Split production intent, stable assignments, and derived state
